from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-e480fa9e.py'
code = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            y0, y1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y in range(y0, y1+1) for x in range(x0, x1+1)
                         if y in (y0, y1) or x in (x0, x1)}
            if len(perimeter) > 0 and set(cells) == perimeter:
                for y in range(y0+1, y1):
                    for x in range(x0+1, x1):
                        out[y][x] = 7
    return out
'''
